Don't think I've shared anything about this yet in here. So, this is what I've been busy working on for the next version of Waydroid-Linux.
Fully reproducible builds using Debian by default this round.
So more or less, I am making AOSP build handle pulling and packaging a lightweight Debian rootfs/initrd, kernel, firmware, etc. and then build the Android images, then pack it all into an ISO with an installer UI.
